name: frequency beats lexical order and ties are lexical
input: frequency beats lexical order and ties are lexical
test:
assert transition_counts('a c a b a c')=={'a':{'c':2,'b':1},'c':{'a':1},'b':{'a':1}}
assert generate_text('a c a b a c','a',3)=='a c a c'
assert generate_text('a c a b','a',3)=='a b'
print('ok')

name: apostrophes punctuation and casing
empty unseen terminal and zero steps
input: empty unseen terminal and zero steps
test:
assert transition_counts('123 !!!')=={}
assert generate_text('', 'Start',10)=='start'
assert generate_text('a b','c',5)=='c'
assert generate_text('a b','b',5)=='b'
assert generate_text('a b','a',0)=='a'
print('ok')
